info.name: YouTube Liquid Glass UI
info.description:
YOUTUBE LIQUID GLASS UI (YT + YT MUSIC)
Give YouTube and YouTube Music a smooth, Apple-style liquid glass look that makes default YouTube feel flat. It is clean, fast, and built to feel natural for everyday watching without slowing down your browser.

QUICK SETUP BEFORE YOU INSTALL:
- Dark Mode Only: Turn on YouTube Dark Theme (Appearance > Dark theme).
- No Extra Themes: Turn off other YouTube styles so borders don't overlap.
- Smooth Glass Tip: Keep "Graphics Acceleration" (or Hardware Acceleration) turned ON in your browser settings.
info.additionalInfo: Note: The main design is now complete, so big visual updates will be slower and less frequent from here on. However, I will still be pushing bug fixes and performance optimizations whenever YouTube changes things on their end. (Certain code refinements and animation tweaks along the way were polished with a bit of AI assistance.*)
